# The discarded errors the living Go still carries without a reason, one
# file:function:shape per row with why it is left (internal/ci/discarded_class_test.go,
# the discarded rule). Each row is a failure that goes silent today and wants a
# change bigger than a comment: a writer the function does not have, a caller
# that drops what it returns, a design call. A row leaves when its site gains
# its `// ignored: <reason>` or is fixed; it never comes back. This list only
# shrinks: the class test fails on a row whose site has left as well as on a
# site that is not listed, and NOVA_CI_UPDATE=1 drops a stale row and never
# adds one.
# A row is `file:function:shape <sites> <reason>`: <sites> is how many sites the row covers, and it
# only falls. A new site under a listed key (a discard with no `// ignored:`, a `|| true`,
# a `2>/dev/null`, a refusal with no remedy, an OK beside a failing exit) makes the
# count too low and the run red, and fixing a site makes the count too high and the
# run red until it is lowered (NOVA_CI_UPDATE=1 lowers it, and never raises one).
# ceiling: 9
cmd/nova-sprint/goal.go:app.goalsView:bare-return 1 a failed goals read leaves the view without its people and says nothing; the frame does not show them, but --json does
cmd/nova-swarm/member.go:nativeRunner.Start:blank 1 the pid file is how a restart finds the running child; a failed write is found only when the restart cannot
cmd/nova-swarm/native.go:writeNativeArgvLog:bare-return 1 the argv proof log is lost with no line; writeNativeArgvLog has no writer to say so
internal/sprint/store/presence.go:Store.strangers:blank 1 an unreadable strangers record is read as no strangers, with no error; the teardown then counts nobody from it as beating
internal/sprint/store/teardown.go:Store.Teardown:blank 1 a view that cannot be deleted is left behind while the teardown reports success
internal/swarm/slots.go:takeSlotLeases:blank 1 a dead worker's card that cannot be returned to queue/ is lost with no line; takeSlotLeases has no writer, and the slot is granted anyway
internal/swarm/stage.go:StageCard:blank 2 a failed git config leaves commits in the staged checkout without an identity, found only when the model commits
internal/tablemodel/replay.go:runHarness:blank 1 a TLC error trace that cannot be copied is lost as evidence with no line
internal/tlc/suite.go:RunSuite:blank 1 a cleanup of the check's own scratch directory, safe to ignore; the reason comment waits for the next TLC re-run, because suite.go is an input every TLC record hashes and a comment there stales them all
